description: Banded blue through green to red down a tan quill. Whatever grew a tail of these has not shown itself yet.
lore: [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] measured one: quill at the base as thick as a bowstring, vane a hand and a half, and a tail wants a dozen at least before it is a tail. From that he got a span. From the span, a weight. From the weight, what a thing that size has to eat in a week and how much country that takes to find it in. He wrote the number down and he has not said it to anyone. What he will say, pushed, is that the country in question would have to be country people walk through, and that people walk through it.
gm_notes: Gunnar's arithmetic, withheld as usual. The animal is deliberately unwritten; what exists is a large flier nobody has met sharing the roads with everybody.
